property_summary: For every call to C's fallback, the reference contract accepts (does not revert) exactly when msg.value == 10 ether; the mutant inverts that check (requires msg.value != 10 ether) so there exist amounts (notably 10 ether) where the mutant's acceptance differs from the reference.
change_summary: Change the equality check of msg.value from == 10 ether to != 10 ether so fallback accepts any call except exactly 10 ether.
